### Long-Term Effects
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-oct-26-2012.html
Passage: Genesis 3:21
Points:
- Adam and Eve's transgression introduced death into a creation that had previously experienced only life.
- Sin inevitably carries painful, long-term consequences that people often fail to foresee.
- Human religion tries in vain to conceal guilt with fragile, self-made coverings like fig leaves.
- God provided animal skins, demonstrating that the penalty for sin requires the shedding of innocent blood.
- The garments of skin point forward to Jesus Christ, the Lamb who takes away the world's sin.
